definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over an extended period. Commonly used in product reviews, manufacturing, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}びたい→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I want to choose a product with excellent durability.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}して→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This building was designed with durability in mind.

notes:
The quality of being able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over time. Formed from ⟦{耐久|たいきゅう}→耐久：18768_taikyuu⟧ (endurance) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (quality/property). Commonly used in product reviews, manufacturing, and construction contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high durability
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in durability
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be durable
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to increase durability
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: durability test

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{耐久|たいきゅう}→耐久：18768_taikyuu⟧: endurance — the base noun without the property suffix
- ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧: sturdy, strong — describes the quality of being tough in everyday language
- ⟦{頑丈|がんじょう}→頑丈：08639_ganjou⟧: robust, solidly built — emphasizes physical sturdiness
